messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall-lucy, oncall-ajay, eng-runtime-ashwin — elevated HF artifact fetch errors (429 / 503) detected starting ~2026-03-15T10:12Z. Please ack and investigate.
oncall-lucy: ack — I'll grab it. Seeing spike in model download failures from huggingface.co during cold starts.
eng-runtime-ashwin: confirming. Model fetch failure rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~14% in the last 5m. Cold starts timing out or taking 8-15s on affected hosts.
eng-sre-noah: symptoms on infra deploys too: prewarm jobs failing when they try to pull artifacts concurrently.
customer-success-maya: we already have two customers reporting increased generation latency / timeout errors (CS-1892, CS-1893). They're asking if this is on our side.
oncall-lucy: sample runtime log:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z ERROR model_fetcher: GET https://huggingface.co/redwood/llama-7b/resolve -> 429 Too Many Requests
Response headers: x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 21
```
eng-platform-sara: are Dedicated/private customers affected?
oncall-lucy: Hosted + Dedicated prewarm (which pulls HF artifacts) are hit. Customers using local mirrors / on-prem not affected.
eng-runtime-ashwin: immediate mitigations we can try: throttle parallel HF pulls, prefer internal S3 mirror if available, stagger prewarm across AZs, add exponential backoff + retry jitter, and contact HF support.
eng-sre-noah: applying a quick concurrency cap on prewarm workers (prewarm.max_concurrency=1) now.
eng-deployment-zoe: rolling a feature flag to flip fetch logic to prefer S3 mirror when present: `feature.hf_fetch_prefer_s3=true`. Deploying to canary.
eng-runtime-ashwin: pushing hotfix branch `hotfix/hf-s3-fallback` — runtime will: 1) check S3 mirror for model artifact, 2) if absent then attempt HF with exponential backoff and circuit-breaker. Canarying to 5 nodes.
eng-runtime-ashwin: hotfix snippet:
```
if s3.has(model_key): download_s3(model_key)
else:
  with circuit_breaker('hf-fetch'):
    fetch_from_hf_with_backoff(model_url)
```
incbot: Incident created INC-2026-hf-fetch, severity P2. Assigned to eng-runtime-ashwin / eng-sre-noah.
oncall-ajay: ack — taking the page at 10:35 UTC. Lucy handing off.
oncall-lucy: handover: root cause suspected HF artifact-host rate-limiting during bursty prewarm + customer cold starts. Actions done: prewarm concurrency gate, canary S3-fallback, CS alerted, incident created. Dashboards pinned under infra/model-fetch.
oncall-ajay: next steps — promote S3-fallback if canary looks good, block any mass prewarm jobs, open HF support ticket with request id and examples. I've opened ticket REDWOOD-4721 with HF: https://huggingface.co/support/tickets/REDWOOD-4721
eng-runtime-ashwin: canary looks healthy — 5 canary nodes served from S3 mirror and cold-start latency dropped back to ~600-900ms. Promoting to 50% rollout.
eng-platform-sara: recommend we maintain an S3 mirror for all models we serve and schedule periodic syncs. Also request HF quota increase for artifact pulls.
eng-security-rita: if we mirror artifacts we need checksum/signature verification and license checks. Add to the runbook.
eng-sre-noah: adding a short-term circuit-breaker rule: if HF 429 rate > 5% across regions, pause HF pulls for 30s and queue requests with backoff. Implementing now.
eng-deployment-zoe: feature flag `feature.hf_fetch_prefer_s3` rolled to hosted regions. New cold-starts will prefer S3.
customer-success-maya: updating customers with mitigation note and ETA for full resolution. One customer asked about SLA credits — routing to ops/legal.
eng-legal-lina: pls cc me on any external SLA/comms.
eng-ops-tony: creating runbook PR titled "HF artifact outage" with steps to pre-seed S3, flip feature flag, and manual unblock instructions.
incbot: Update: mitigation in place, incident status: mitigated -> continue monitoring. Next update in 30m or on significant change.
eng-runtime-ashwin: metrics after rollout: HF 429s dropped from 14% -> ~1.5%, cold-start failures reduced by ~92%.
oncall-ajay: handing night to oncall-maya at 18:00 UTC. Handover note: monitor INC-2026-hf-fetch, HF ticket REDWOOD-4721, and infra/model-fetch dashboards.
oncall-maya: ack. Monitoring channel and alerting.
eng-runtime-ashwin: post-incident action items (short):
- INC-A1: implement persistent S3 mirror + scheduled sync and verify checksums (owner: eng-platform-sara)
- INC-A2: bake HF circuit-breaker + backoff into runtime (owner: eng-sre-noah)
- INC-A3: include small quantized fallback model on node images (owner: eng-runtime-ashwin)
- INC-A4: runbook + CS template for third-party artifact host outages (owner: eng-ops-tony)
customer-success-maya: will draft external summary for impacted customers after postmortem.
eng-runtime-ashwin: no auth tokens exposed; this is availability-only. Security impact: none detected.
eng-sre-noah: scheduling internal postmortem within 72h; external customer summary target in 96h.
incbot: Incident INC-2026-hf-fetch status updated to: mitigated -> severity lowered to P3.
oncall-maya: will escalate if HF responds with long ETA or if error rate climbs. Monitoring. :eyes:
